summary.text: Paul Friel is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 26 who has served since December 1, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Friel is a business owner who previously served on a school board.

paragraphs.text: Paul Friel was born in Gilbertsville, Pennsylvania, graduated from St. Pius X High School in 1987 and earned a bachelor's degree from Temple University in 1993.
His career experience includes owning and managing PACE Environmental and working in executive management, and he has served on the boards of the Philadelphia Boys' Choir and Camp Rainbow.

In a 2020 Ballotpedia survey, Friel described himself as a business owner, school board member, and advocate for public education and environmental stewardship, and said he was a member of the Owen J. Roberts School Board.
He listed strengthening education, environmental stewardship and protecting natural lands, and economic recovery that prioritizes local businesses as his key campaign messages.
Friel assumed office in the Pennsylvania House on December 1, 2022, succeeding Timothy Hennessey.
In the 2023-2024 session he was assigned to the Agriculture and Rural Affairs, Education, Environmental Resources and Energy, and Game and Fisheries committees.
